title: chloroleucon dumosum
intro: Chloroleucon dumosum, commonly known as West Indian ebony, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its purported health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of West Indian ebony include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Chloroleucon dumosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
